title: Move the quest/lore pair from 0.14.2 to 0.15.0: mark the agents --check exit-code change breaking (ODOC-556 ruling OA-r354-pair-0142-semver)
description: opum-doc ruled 2026-10-31 (ODOC-556, OA-r354-pair-0142-semver, option A): the pair ships as 0.15.0, not 0.14.2. CD-1 (docs/standards/deployment-releases-and-environments.md) counts breaking by what a caller built against and names a remapped exit code; `agents --check` going from exit 0 to 6 on an unchanged Codex-only or Antigravity workspace is breaking for anyone running it in CI. CD-3: a breaking change MUST be labelled in the CHANGELOG, and either repository breaking marker forces the pair to at least minor. So the CHANGELOG entry carries the breaking marker the breaking_bump gate reads (a `### ... (breaking)` heading), keeping the upgrade step (run quest agents --update-instructions, then delete the old-path skill file by hand), and the gate then enforces the minor bump itself. #706 landed at 0.14.2 (squash 002f53ba); this task changes every 0.14.2 declaration to 0.15.0, renames the CHANGELOG heading, and rebuilds the six binaries. lore-check.yml was pinned in the same PR once lore-cli#702 had its 0.15.0 head (af4bc9d8, third commit afc467d1); landed as #709 (squash 81645e55). That pin is a PR-branch head, so QCLI-550 re-points it to lore's dev squash after lore-cli#702 lands. QCLI-328 gap (the gate keys only on the heading, so an unlabelled break passes) is information only, not filed.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every 0.14.2 version declaration #706 set reads 0.15.0: package.json and its six optionalDependencies, the six npm/quest-*/package.json, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, src/application/version.ts, src/contract/tracker/index.ts, fixtures/tracker/v1/conformance.json, bun.lock pins, and the CLAUDE.md managed-block version
The six platform binaries are rebuilt at 0.15.0 and every questBinarySha256 and the questPlatformPackages map match the bytes (check:packages, check:lockfile and test:packages exit 0)

CHANGELOG has ## 0.15.0 with a ### ... (breaking) heading carrying the Codex/Antigravity agents --check change and its upgrade step; check-breaking-bump goes red at 0.14.x and green at 0.15.0 over the same notes
lore-check.yml is pinned to lore 0.15.0 and lore-cli#702 new head by ref, and lore check is green on the final head
The pair lands under fresh Opus review at the final heads of both repositories

implementationNotes: Landed as #709, squash 81645e558d2548aaabd542080d00c6718e43a9d1 on origin/dev (merged with --match-head-commit afc467d1 after the operator marked it ready, dec-0kfl7kc A; source-gates, Tracker integrity and lore check success). The squash subject still reads "DRAFT, lore pin pending" because it took the PR title at merge; the content is the final head. ACs 1-4 checked on evidence: parity list and sha pairs (reviewer, check:packages, check:lockfile), test:packages and bun run check 0 (1366 pass), check-breaking-bump red at 0.14.2 and green at 0.15.0, lore check green with the pin. AC 5 stays open: the lore side (lore-cli#702 under its own review) and the tag/publish sequence under QCLI-547. Status In Progress for that remainder.

VERDICT: APPROVE afc467d106271664adcf67d1d00c7e79111bb8a1
1. Version parity holds (non-blocking): 0.15.0 across package.json:3 + six optionalDependencies, six npm/quest-*/package.json, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, src/application/version.ts:19, src/contract/tracker/index.ts:23, fixtures/tracker/v1/conformance.json:3, six bun.lock pins, the CLAUDE.md managed block; each questPlatformPackages sha256 equals its manifest's questBinarySha256 (0ed4bb0f, a00dacbb, a5520d59, 3f35058b, 234dbc05, 57af52bc). The only `0.14.2` outside .quest/ is CHANGELOG.md:60, prose on why 0.14.2 was skipped.
2. CHANGELOG entry under a gate-recognised heading (non-blocking): CHANGELOG.md:15 `### Changed (breaking)` matches BREAKING_HEADING `/^###\s.*\(breaking\)/im` (scripts/check-breaking-bump.mjs:58). The entry moved whole (old lines 57-93 unchanged context); the only addition is the Upgrade step paragraph :56-62; the rest of the section is re-emitted verbatim.
3. The upgrade step matches the code (non-blocking): checkLeftoverClaudeSkill (src/application/agents/agent-instructions.ts:274-300) reports and never deletes; --update-instructions writes .agents/skills/quest/SKILL.md (codexQuestSkillPath, :247).
4. Gate passes here, would fail a patch bump (non-blocking, reasoned): `## 0.15.0` vs previous `## 0.14.1 - 2026-10-20` (CHANGELOG.md:198) is minor; renamed to 0.14.2 it is patch and fails at :130. Blind spot, information only: `--next 0.14.3` finds no section, falls to empty `## Unreleased`, reads not-breaking and passes; same class as the QCLI-328 gap; nothing in this PR affected.
5. lore-check.yml changes only what it should (non-blocking): comment wording, LORE_SOURCE_REF (:148), npm pin plus two notices (:200-205); :245-257 asserts lore --version equals 0.15.0 by either install method and :215 refuses a non-commit ref. Limit: af4bc9d8 being lore-cli#702's 0.15.0 head not verifiable by reading.
6. No hidden behaviour change and no contract-version change (non-blocking): contractVersion 1, fixtureVersion 1; only two version literals in src.
7. CHANGELOG.md:63-64 double blank line before `### Changed` (non-blocking, cosmetic); no markdown lint configured.
8. .quest/tasks/QCLI-551.json stale against the head (non-blocking, tracker): description says lore-check.yml is NOT pinned until #702 has a new head, but afc467d1 pins it; status still To Do. Update at the next tracker write.
Limits: the six binaries not verifiable by reading (check:packages, test:packages and CI own that); lore's CHANGELOG not read; both-sides marker enforced by the --pair gate at release time, not here.

TICKED AC5 (2026-11-02), on the leader's instruction, with the evidence per side. Quest side, each review an Opus unit: VERDICT APPROVE at afc467d1, the final head of opum-ai/quest-cli#709 (note 2 on this task, merged as opum-ai/quest-cli#710); VERDICT APPROVE from unit quest-cli-review-712 at f86d343c over the only later non-tracker change, the one-line LORE_SOURCE_REF re-point in opum-ai/quest-cli#712; VERDICT APPROVE from unit quest-cli-review-718 at 9b89de369118acb8461b10ce58a94357696a8b8b (spawn-model MATCH claude-opus-5-5) over opum-ai/quest-cli#718, the macos-15 runner fix; tagged main is e0a559ddb2f85b369b7560aa2df1073f6daf5d1d, whose non-tracker diff from afc467d1 is exactly those two reviewed changes. Lore side: reported to me by the leader as lore-cli#712 under Opus APPROVE at ada4d738; I did not read that review myself, so that half rests on the leader's report.
